description: Sub-division of existing Class E barber shop to Class E Office to the rear and Class E barber shop to the front (Application for a Certificate of Lawful Development for a Proposed Development)
decision_conditions: The Council is satisfied on the evidence adduced to it that the subdivision of the application site from its existing lawful use (Class E) to a barbershop (Class E) and office (Class E) would not constitute development requiring planning permission as per the conditions and limitations of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 and the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, as amended by The Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) (Amendment) (England) Regulations 2020. As such, planning permission for the proposed subdivision is not required.

The applicant is to note that, this certificate relates to the proposed use class of the unit only and does not grant planning consent for any external changes or advertisements which may be required as a result of the unit's conversion.
